submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 8 (Bi 0.094, Cu 0.443, V 0.463) had the highest photocurrent: 4.76e-5 A. That is about twice the BiVO4-rich site 143 (2.29e-5 A) and a little above its Cu-V neighbour 119 (4.30e-5 A). So the Cu-V-rich, low-Bi region near Cu:V ≈ 1:1 did better than the BiVO4-rich region.

rejected.reason: BiVO4-rich composition; its measured photocurrent (2.29e-5 A) was about half that of index 8
More Cu than index 8 (Cu:V > 1); its photocurrent (4.30e-5 A) was slightly lower than index 8's
Its XRD pattern closely matched 143 (same BiVO4-rich phase region), so its merit was not measured and the budget went to other regions
